blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have transformed computational pathology through powerful representation learning from histopathological images. PFMs provide rich, discriminative representations for whole slide image (WSI) analysis, enabling tasks such as slide-level classification under multiple instance learning (MIL). However, these representations may also encode non-biological signals associated with acquisition centers, potentially introducing spurious shortcuts into downstream predictions. In this work, we evaluate center-associated robustness in WSI classification using a controlled training setting with increasing class-center correlations quantified by Cramér’s V V . We benchmark six PFMs across four datasets and two MIL aggregators, while evaluating ComBat as a robustification strategy. We further introduce the Area Under the Cramér’s V V Curve (AUCC) to jointly capture absolute classification performance and its degradation as spurious correlation increases. Results show that center-related information encoded by PFMs propagates to WSI-level predictions, with robustness depending on both the PFM representation and MIL aggregation strategy. Additionally, ComBat harmonization does not provide consistent robustness gains across datasets.
blocks.zh: 病理学基础模型(PFMs)通过从组织病理学图像中学习的强势表现,改变了计算病理学. PFM为全幻灯片映像分析(WSI)提供了丰富,具有歧视性的表示方式,在多实例学习(MIL)下可以实现幻灯片级分类等任务. 然而,这些表述还可能编码与收购中心有关的非生物信号,从而有可能在下游预测中引入虚假的捷径。 在这项工作中,我们利用控制的培训环境来评价中心关联的WSI分类的稳健性,这种环境与Cramér的V V量化的班级中心关联性越来越大。 我们以6个PFM为基准,涵盖4个数据集和2个MIL聚合器,同时评价ComBat是强化战略。 我们进一步引入Cramér V V Curve(AUCC)下的区域,以联合记录绝对分类性能及其随着虚假关联增加而退化的情况。 结果表明,由PFM编码的与中心有关的信息传播到WSI一级的预测,其强性取决于PFM的表示和MIL的汇总战略. 此外,ComBat的协调统一并不能提供各数据集一致的稳健性收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The emergence of pathology foundation models (PFMs) have notably enhanced AI-based workflows in computational pathology (CPath) [ 11 ] . Due to high-capacity model architectures and large-scale, self-supervised, in-domain pretraining, PFMs extract powerful data representations from histopathological images. Their enhanced representational learning has enhanced CPath algorithms for tasks such as whole slide image (WSI) classification. Given the gigapixel scale of WSIs, multiple instance learning (MIL) has become the most prominent approach for WSI classification, requiring only WSI-level annotations [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 病理基础模型(PFMs)的出现,显著加强了计算病理(CPath)中基于AI的工作流程[11]. 由于能力大,模型架构规模大,自我监督,域内预训,PFMs从组织病理学图像中提取了强大的数据表示. 他们增强的代表学习加强了CPath算法,用于全幻灯片图像(WSI)分类等任务. 鉴于WSI的千兆像素尺度,多例学习(MIL)已经成为WSI分类最突出的方法,只需要WSI级说明[2].

blocks.en: Beyond disease-related biological patterns, PFMs have been shown to encode signals associated with center-specific procedures [ 7 ] . Across pathology departments, differences in tissue processing, staining protocols, and digitization scanners can introduce variations in color, intensity, and other image characteristics. These technical signatures may act as spurious shortcuts, causing downstream models to rely on center-related information rather than biological signal and limiting generalization across centers. Although large-scale in-domain pretraining may improve robustness to such shifts, its impact on clinically relevant downstream predictions remains an important consideration.
blocks.zh: 除了与疾病有关的生物模式外,PFM还被证明可以编码与中心特定程序相关的信号[7]. 在整个病理学系,组织处理的不同,污渍协议,数字化扫描仪可以引入颜色,强度等图像特征的变化. 这些技术签名可能是虚假的捷径,导致下游模型依赖与中心有关的信息而不是生物信号,并限制了跨中心通俗化。 虽然大规模的域内预训可以提高这种转变的稳健性,但其对临床相关下游预测的影响仍然是一个重要考虑因素。

blocks.en: In this work, we evaluate center-associated robustness in WSI-level prediction using a weakly supervised MIL framework. We construct controlled training settings with increasing class–center correlations quantified by Cramér’s V V and assess how these spurious associations propagate to downstream predictions across PFMs and MIL aggregators. We further introduce the Area Under the Cramér’s V V Curve (AUCC), which jointly captures absolute classification performance and performance degradation as center–label correlation increases. Finally, we evaluate ComBat harmonization [ 6 ] as a robustification strategy for mitigating center-associated variation in PFM representations.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们利用一个受到薄弱监督的MIL框架,评价在WSI一级预测中与中心有关的稳健性。 并评估这些虚伪的社团如何传播到下游的预测, 我们进一步引入了Cramér V V Curve(AUCC)下的区域,该区域共同将绝对分类性能和性能退化作为中心-标签关联性增加的一部分。 最后,我们评价ComBat协调[6]是缓解PFM表述中与中心相关的差异的有力战略。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: This section presents our framework for evaluating center-associated robustness of PFMs under spurious correlations. Figure 1 summarizes the overall approach and its main components are detailed below.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们在虚假关联下评价中心关联的可持续森林管理稳健性的框架。 图1汇总了总体办法,主要构成部分详述如下。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Framework overview: (A) MIL-based WSI classification, (B) center-label spurious correlations, and (C) Robustness quantification.
blocks.zh: 图1:框架概览:(A)基于MIL的WSI分类,(B)中心标签的虚假关联,(C)强力量化.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multiple Instance Learning (MIL)
blocks.zh: 2.1 多例学习

blocks.en: In MIL, each WSI is represented as a bag X = { x n } n = 1 N X=\{x_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N} of N N image patches and assigned a slide-level label y ∈ Y y\in{Y} , where Y {Y} denotes the set of target classes. A PFM encoder maps each patch into a feature representation in c c , which is subsequently aggregated by a trainable MIL module into a slide-level embedding z z . Finally, an MLP maps z z to the prediction y ^ \hat{y} , and the downstream model is optimized using the cross-entropy loss ℒ C ​ E \mathcal{L}_{CE} .
2.2 Center-Label Spurious Correlations
blocks.zh: 2.2 中心-标签纯性关联

blocks.en: To assess reliance on center-related shortcuts, we construct training sets with progressively stronger associations between the class label y ∈ Y y\in Y and acquisition center h ∈ H h\in H , while keeping the number of WSIs fixed. The association is quantified through Cramér’s V V ,

V = χ 2 M ​ min ⁡ ( | Y | − 1 , | H | − 1 ) , χ 2 = ∑ y ∈ Y ∑ h ∈ H ( O y ​ h − E y ​ h ) 2 E y ​ h , V=\sqrt{\frac{\chi^{2}}{M\min(|Y|-1,\,|H|-1)}},\hskip 9.24994pt\chi^{2}=\sum_{y\in Y}\sum_{h\in H}\frac{(O_{yh}-E_{yh})^{2}}{E_{yh}},

where M M is the number of training WSIs, and O y ​ h O_{yh} and E y ​ h E_{yh} are the observed and expected counts for each class-center pair. As shown in Figure 1 B, Cramér’s V ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] V\in[0,1] ranges from independence ( V = 0 V=0 ) to maximal association ( V = 1 V=1 ). The test set is always kept uncorrelated ( V = 0 V=0 ), such that performance degradation reflects reliance on the spurious center-label association.
blocks.zh: 其中M M 是训练WSI的数量,O y h o_{yh 和E y _{yh)是观察到的和预期的每对班级中心数。 如图1 B所示,Cramér的V [0, 1] V\in [0, 1] 从独立(V=0 V=0)到最大关联(V=1 V=1)不等. 测试集总是保持不相关(V=0 V=0),因此性能退化反映了对虚假的中标签关联的依赖.

blocks.en: 2.3 Robustness Quantification with AUCC
blocks.zh: 2.3 与非盟协调会的实力量化

blocks.en: To summarize downstream robustness across the different center-label correlations, we propose the Area Under the Cramér’s V V Curve (AUCC) score. Given the ordered configurations { V t } t = 0 T \{V_{t}\}_{t=0}^{T} , we compute the area under the balanced-accuracy curve using trapezoidal integration, AUCC = ∑ t = 1 T BACC ⁡ ( V t ) + BACC ⁡ ( V t − 1 ) 2 ​ ( V t − V t − 1 ) , \mathrm{AUCC}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\frac{\mathrm{BACC}(V_{t})+\mathrm{BACC}(V_{t-1})}{2}\left(V_{t}-V_{t-1}\right), where BACC ⁡ ( V t ) \mathrm{BACC}(V_{t}) denotes the balanced accuracy obtained when training under correlation level V t V_{t} , and T + 1 T+1 is the number of evaluated configurations. Unlike measuring performance degradation at a single correlation level, AUCC jointly captures absolute predictive performance and its stability as the spurious association increases. Thus, higher AUCC indicates a stronger performance-robustness trade-off across the complete range of center–label correlations.
3 Experimental design
blocks.zh: 3 实验设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We evaluate four binary WSI classification tasks spanning skin (AI4SKIN [ 4 ] ), breast (CAMELYON16 [ 8 ] , TCGA-BRCA) and lung (TCGA-NSCLC) cancer. For each dataset, we retain WSIs from two acquisition centers, enabling controlled manipulation of center-label correlations. Table 1 summarizes the resulting class and center distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四个二进制的WSI分类任务,涉及皮肤(AI4SKIN [4]),乳房(CAMELYON16 [8],TCGA-BRCA)和肺癌(TCGA-NSCLC). 对于每个数据集,我们保留了两个收购中心的WSI,从而可以控制地操纵中心-标签关联. 表1汇总了由此产生的类别和中心分布情况。

blocks.en: Table 1 : WSI distribution by class and acquisition center. IDC: invasive ductal carcinoma; ILC: invasive lobular carcinoma; LUAD: lung adenocarcinoma; LUSC: lung squamous cell carcinoma.
blocks.zh: 表1:按类别和收购中心划分的WSI分配情况。 IDC:入侵性胶囊癌;ILC:入侵性胶囊癌;LUAD:肺腺癌;LUSC:肺腺细胞癌。

blocks.en: WSIs undergo tissue detection, downsampling to 10 × 10\times magnification (1 MPP), and tiling into 512 × 512 512\times 512 patches. We deliberately avoid stain normalization to preserve center-associated appearance and apply the input transformations prescribed by each PFM.
blocks.zh: WSI进行组织检测,下取样到10×10\时放大(1个MPP),并滴入512×512512\时的补丁. 我们刻意避免污点正常化,以保持中央相关外观,并应用每个PFM规定的输入转换.

blocks.en: Table 2 : AUCC robustness of patch-level pathology FMs across datasets and MIL aggregators. Arrows denote the absolute percentage-point change after ComBat correction. Model years indicate the initial public release of each PFM, rather than the publication year of the associated reference.
blocks.zh: 表2:AUCC跨数据集和MIL聚合器的补丁级病理调频强度。 箭头表示ComBat修正后的绝对百分点变化. 模型年表示每个PFM的初始公开发布,而不是相关参考文献的发布年份.

blocks.en: 3.2 Models and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式和评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate six frozen PFMs: CONCH [ 9 ] and KEEP [ 14 ] as vision-language models, and VIRCHOW-2 [ 15 ] , H-Optimus-1 [ 12 ] , KAIKO [ 1 ] , and UNI-2 [ 3 ] as vision-only models. Slide-level aggregation uses ABMIL [ 5 ] and TransMIL [ 13 ] , trained for 20 epochs with AdamW and learning rates of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 10 − 5 10^{-5} , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了六种冻结的PFM:CONCH [9]和KEE [14]作为视觉语言模型,VIRCHOW-2 [15],H-Optimus-1 [12],KAIKO [1],UNI-2 [3]作为只视觉模型. 幻灯片级聚合使用ABMIL [5]和TransMIL [13],为20个世纪培训,学习率分别为10 - 4 10 - 4}和10 - 5 10 - 5 。

blocks.en: We use 5-fold cross-validation and evaluate five levels of Cramér’s V V , with V ∈ { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } V\in\{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} . Each configuration is repeated over 10 random training-set samplings while keeping the test fold fixed and uncorrelated ( V = 0 V=0 ), with results averaged across folds and samplings.
blocks.zh: 我们使用5倍的交叉验证,并评估Cramér的VV的5级,其中V {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}V\in\{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}. 每个配置在10个随机的训练集抽样中重复,同时保持测试折叠固定且不相关(V=0 V=0),结果平均跨折叠和抽样.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Representation-Level Center Encoding
blocks.zh: 4.1 代表级中心编码

blocks.en: Representation-level center encoding is assessed on mean-pooled slide embeddings using FM-SI [ 10 ] and RI [ 7 ] . FM-SI measures center-wise clustering (lower is better), whereas RI contrasts biological- and center-driven neighborhood structure (higher is better).
blocks.zh: 代表级中心编码是通过使用FM-SI[10]和RI[7]的中间集合幻灯片嵌入来评估的. FM-SI衡量中向集群(下比更好),而RI对比生物和中向的邻里结构(较高更好).

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Slide-level robustness of patch-level pathology foundation models across center-related metrics.
blocks.zh: 图2:跨中心相关度量的补丁级病理基础模型的幻灯片级稳健性.

blocks.en: Figure 2 reveals substantial differences in center robustness across PFMs, with lower FM-SI consistently associated with higher RI. CONCH and KEEP occupy the most robust region of the representation space, whereas KAIKO shows the strongest center-related encoding, followed by H-Optimus-1. Notably, both vision-language PFMs outperform all vision-only models on the two complementary metrics, suggesting that, within our benchmark, multimodal pretraining yields representations less dominated by acquisition-center information.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,不同调频系统在中心稳健度方面存在巨大差异,调频系统低调与较高调频系统相关联。 CONCH和KEEP占据了代表空间中最坚固的区域,而KAIKO则表现出最强的中枢相关编码,其次是H-Optimus-1. 值得注意的是,两种视觉语言的PFM在两个互补的衡量标准上都超过了所有只使用视觉的模型,这表明,在我们的基准范围内,多式联运预训所产生的表现较少受到采购中心信息的支配。

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness to Spurious Correlations
blocks.zh: 4.2 对纯洁关联的强力

blocks.en: Downstream performance is measured by BACC, while AUCC summarizes performance and robustness across the full range of Cramér’s V V .
blocks.zh: 下游的业绩由BACC衡量,而AUCC则总结了整个Cramér V V的绩效和稳健性.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : BACC under increasing spurious center–label correlation.
blocks.zh: 图3:BACC在不断增长的虚假中心-标签相关性下。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that, without robustification, ABMIL achieves higher average AUCC for five out of six PFMs, outperforming TransMIL by 1.18 percentage points on average. This indicates that the aggregation strategy itself influences downstream robustness, with ABMIL generally preserving performance better under spurious center–label correlations. Figure 3 further reveals a consistent performance degradation as the correlation increases across models and datasets. CONCH and KEEP remain notably robust on TCGA-BRCA at high V V , whereas most configurations deteriorate substantially, showing that center information encoded in PFM representations can propagate to slide-level predictions through spurious shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,ABMIL在6个PFM中,有5个达到较高的AUCC平均数,而跨MIL的成绩平均比1.18个百分点。 这表明汇总战略本身影响了下游的稳健性,ABMIL一般在虚假的中枢-标签的关联下更好地保存性能. 图3还显示,随着模型和数据集之间相互关系的增加,业绩持续退化。 CONCH和KEEP在高VV的TCGA-BRCA上仍然显著强劲,而大多数配置都大幅恶化,表明PFM表示编码的中央信息可以通过虚假的捷径传播到幻灯片级预测.

blocks.en: 4.3 Effect of ComBat Harmonization
blocks.zh: 4.3 ComBat协调的效果

blocks.en: As a widely used harmonization strategy, we apply ComBat [ 6 ] to mitigate center-associated bias in PFM embeddings. ComBat estimates and removes center-specific additive and scale effects while preserving biological variation.
blocks.zh: 作为广泛使用的协调统一策略,我们应用ComBat [6]来缓解PFM嵌入式中枢关联偏差. ComBat在保留生物变异的同时,估计并消除中心特有的添加剂和规模效应.

blocks.en: Despite this correction, ComBat does not provide consistent robustness gains. Across the 48 PFM-aggregator-dataset configurations, AUCC decreases in 34 cases and improves in only 14, yielding an average change of − 0.63 -0.63 percentage points. Moreover, its effect is strongly dataset-dependent, with frequent improvements on CAMELYON16 but almost systematic degradation on TCGA-BRCA. These results suggest that generic feature harmonization is insufficient to reliably mitigate center-related shortcuts and may compromise discriminative information in some settings.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这一更正,ComBat并没有提供持续有力的收益。 在48个PFM-汇总数据集配置中,AUCC减少34个,仅14个改进,平均变化0.63-0.63个百分点。 此外,它的作用非常依赖数据集,经常改进CAMELYON16,但几乎系统降解到TCGA-BRCA。 这些结果表明,通用特征的统一不足以可靠地减轻与中心有关的捷径,并可能损害某些环境中的歧视性信息。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work provides a controlled evaluation of center-related robustness in pathology foundation models, showing that center information encoded at the representation level can propagate to downstream WSI classification under spurious center–label correlations. Across six PFMs, four datasets, and two MIL aggregators, the proposed AUCC enables a unified assessment of predictive performance and robustness, while ComBat provides limited and inconsistent mitigation of center effects. Our study is nevertheless constrained by the controlled Cramér’s V V setting, which restricts the available training samples and focuses on binary tasks with two acquisition centers, as well as by the use of two MIL aggregators and patch-level PFMs. Future work will therefore extend this analysis to broader clinical settings and slide-level foundation models, while developing center-robust foundation models and plug-in robustification strategies that can mitigate acquisition-related shortcuts without compromising discriminative information.
blocks.zh: 这项工作对病理基础模型中与中心相关的强性提供了有控制的评价,表明在代表级别编码的中心信息可以在虚假中心-标签关联下传播到下游的WSI分类. 在6个PFM、4个数据集和2个MIL聚合器中,拟议的AUCC能够对预测性能和稳健性进行统一评估,而ComBat则对中心效应提供有限和不一致的缓解。 然而,我们的研究受到控制下的Cramér V V 设置的限制,它限制了现有的培训样本,并侧重于有两个采购中心的二进制任务,还受到使用两个MIL聚合器和补丁级PFM的限制。 因此,今后的工作将把这一分析推广到更广泛的临床环境和幻灯片级基础模型,同时开发中心-robust基础模型和插件强力化战略,在不损害歧视性信息的情况下减少与获取相关的快捷方式。
